segments.text: Scrolling through the curative lies, filter truth with pixel eyes.
Echo chamber serenade, AI knows just what you hate.
No debate, just clickbait rage, truth imprisoned in a data cage.
Facts are optional outbreak cells, welcome to algorithmic hell.
Feed decides who we should blame.
No nuance here, just black or white.
Give thoughts, at least not yours, by right.
Fake news tattooed on your soul.
Sold your mind for hearts and scrolls We're trapped in algorithm nation Mind controlled by personalization Watch us march to simulation Truth deleted by corporation

Terms of service didn't read Signed your brain to the data feed It's not surveillance, it's just your taste Until your vote and mine are replaced Screaming from algorithm nation Click to agree to your sedation One like closer to damnation AI smiles with no salvation Feed me lies Optimize
